items.headline: Russia threatens 'hostile' Estonia with open war
items.summary: The threat follows Estonia's decision last week to shut its road border crossings with Russia after an attack on a drone maker.

items.headline: At least 15 killed in Kyiv region as Russian attacks intensify
items.summary: Separately, Zelenskyy said Ukraine was behind the drone attacks on Russian ships off Libya.

items.headline: Thousands evacuated from Manchester arena after substance released
items.summary: More than 12,000 people left the Co-op Live venue after an unknown substance was released during a concert.

items.headline: FTSE 100 rebounds 1.3% as banks and miners rally
items.summary: The index closed at 10,480.82 on Monday. Barclays rose 3.65%, HSBC 3.24% and Glencore 3.10%, though softer UK PMI data limited gains.

items.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive
items.summary: Huang returns with immediate effect, just over a week after resigning over revelations of extramarital affairs.

items.headline: AMD and Saudi Arabia's HUMAIN agree up to $10bn AI deal
items.summary: The partnership will deploy 500 megawatts of AMD-based computing in Saudi Arabia and the US over five years.

items.headline: OpenAI's chief scientist proposes industry-wide limits on AI progress
items.summary: He warned AI could start speeding up its own training as soon as 2027, faster than safety research can keep up.

items.headline: Anthropic launches a proactive AI agent
items.summary: The new agent expands Anthropic's range of AI tools.

items.headline: Trump and Xi discussed safeguards on military AI
items.summary: The two leaders talked about rules for AI in the military, according to The Neuron's daily round-up.
